findings.passage: Whatever side of the fence you are on regarding elections, it is obvious that the people's belief in election integrity has been damaged. We need to restore voter's faith in one of the most fundamental aspects of our country. Voter ID and stopping the mass mailing of absentee ballot applications is a great start.
findings.note: From the issues post on his 2022 campaign site (post date from page metadata). Names voter ID and an end to mass mailing of absentee ballot applications as steps to restore trust in elections.
